info.prompt: The "Gothic Hacker" aesthetic manifests as {carved stone interfaces|holographic stained glass} displaying real-time data streams, with {Horror tier 1|Roguelike tier 2|Casino tier 3} modules pulsing to their respective genres' rhythms—{sub-bass heartbeat LFOs|mutating facet sigils|oscillating volatility traces}—while the remaining 17 nodes hum at lower intensity, their {synaptic tendrils|fiber-optic veins} twitching with latent potential.
